text:
nina: Quick thread: after the last batch migration we got mixed signals. Some tenants had cost blips that correlated with model fallbacks (variant mismatch) not just cache warmup. We should make sure our migration UI and telemetry separate those two causes.

omar: Agreed. Suggest we surface two separate counters in migration panel: `fallback_model_tokens` and `warmup_cache_tokens`. They can both feed into the total but we should display drivers.

lucas: Telemetry plan: tag responses with `model_variant` and `matched_model` boolean (true if the requested model variant served). On mismatch set `fallback=true`. We'll also tag `kv_hit=true/false`.

telemetry-bot: note: historical data shows 12% of migration spikes were fallback-driven in previous run.

nina: UX ask: in the migration panel show "driver" breakdown as donut chart and timeline with stack. Allow filters for "fallback" or "cache warmup". Also show the most common fallback variant names so SEs can advise customers to pin models.

vivian: Policy question: Do we bill for fallback model tokens at the fallback model's rate or at the original requested model's rate? Our billing docs are ambiguous.

omar: We currently bill at the model actually served. That surprised some customers; recommend we surface to them in the panel and consider a temporary grace billing policy for the first 5 minutes of migration if fallback_rate > 20%.

ops: For ops, add an alert that triggers when `fallback_model_tokens` > 30% of total tokens in 1m for a tenant. Also when specific fallback variant appears often, create a suggestion: "pin to variant X".

nina: Implementation plan: 1) add model_variant + kv_hit tags (lucas), 2) aggregated counters for fallback/warmup (lucas), 3) panel UX (vivian), 4) billing policy review doc and temporary grace flag (billing + legal + ops).

lucas: I'll instrument tags and aggregator. We'll sample raw traces but keep 1m aggregates for dashboards.

vivian: I'll do mocks and wording. Let's avoid implying refunds; say "billed based on model served" and link to policy.

nina: Good. Can we pilot the grace-billing flag for a small set of tenants while we evaluate complaints?

omar: Yes, we can route their migration through a billing shim that records what would be billed vs what is billed and surface the difference. No automatic refunds until legal ok.

telemetry-bot: todo: add migration dashboard panel to the ops runbook.

nina: thanks. Anyone want to own end-to-end test? I'll take it with ops help.

ops: We should also add a customer-facing FAQ entry for "Why did my bill change during migration?". Product, can you own?

vivian: I'll draft FAQ + console copy.

nina: Great. Landing timeline: tags & aggregates by Thu, dashboard Friday, pilot next week.
